_what: Pore-pressure relaxation and the Reynolds-dilatancy ceiling for 800 nm silica vs 10 um cornstarch.

_conventions.drainage_length_contact: 0.49 D0, the contact-patch radius at peak force from the Wagner analysis

silica_phi0.50.K_p_origin: EDL affine modulus K_p = P(44.2327 Pa) a / (6 lambda_D), lambda_D = 10 nm; bracket = lambda_D 30 nm (0 mM) to 1 nm (100 mM). P_conf set to the fitted sigma*.

silica_phi0.44_lab.K_p_origin: EDL affine modulus K_p = P(44.2327 Pa) a / (6 lambda_D), lambda_D = 10 nm; bracket = lambda_D 30 nm (0 mM) to 1 nm (100 mM). P_conf set to the fitted sigma*.

cornstarch_phi0.42.K_p_origin: affine modulus with Hertz k_n at P_conf = 100000 Pa, E_p = 1e+08 Pa (bracket 1e7-1e9); delta/a = 2.26e-02

glass_beads_JVF_validation.K_p_origin: affine modulus with Hertz k_n at P_conf = 10000 Pa, E_glass = 7e+10 Pa; low end = /5 for non-affine relaxation. Affine is an upper bound.

contrast_headline.note: Each system is evaluated at ITS OWN operating pressure (silica P_conf = sigma* = 44 Pa; cornstarch P_conf = 1e5 Pa, the measured jammed-column stress). Read with contrast_at_matched_P_conf below, which shows how much of the stiffness factor is the pressure difference rather than the materials.

contrast_at_matched_P_conf._why: The stiffness contrast in contrast_headline is largely the difference in operating pressure, not a material property. At matched P_conf the two networks are comparably stiff and the whole diffusivity contrast collapses onto the a^2 permeability factor. The undrained verdict for silica survives every entry here by at least two decades, which is what makes it the robust conclusion.

dilatant_amplification.definition: p_dil_max / P_conf = (a/6 lambda_D) dphi/(1-phi); P_conf cancels, so this does not inherit sigma*'s uncertainty. >1 means frustrated dilation amplifies.
dilatant_amplification.sensitivity_note: phi* depends on phi_c, which is UNMEASURED for this silica. phi_c = 0.42 is assumed throughout; phi* moves with it roughly one-for-one.
